chunks: There is no riba between a Muslim and a dhimmi, nor between a woman and her husband.

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.اَلْمَرْأَةِ: the woman; wife in this context
key_terms.رِبًا: usury; unlawful increase in a financial transaction

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on riba between a Muslim and a dhimmi, or between a wife and her husband?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning riba in two specific relational contexts: between a Muslim and a dhimmi, and between a wife and her husband. It is cited in the chapter on usury, indicating its relevance to fiqh discussions of financial transactions and family law.
